raw.details:
Overview:

"Pitch Premier" is a flagship event for undergraduate and postgraduate students, designed to provide a high-impact platform for transforming innovative ideas into business ventures. It offers an opportunity to showcase entrepreneurial talent and emphasizes strategic planning in areas like research, development, intellectual property protection, and patent rights. This is your moment to present your creativity, strategy, and vision before an audience that values innovation.

Event Structure:

Phase I: Submission of Executive Summary:

  • Format: All documents must be submitted in PDF format only via the respective dashboard.
  • Subject Line: The document must be titled: "Pitch Premier Executive Summary – Techkriti '27."
  • Submission Requirements:
    • All documents must be submitted in a single attempt, late submissions will incur a penalty.
    • Participants must fill out the Executive Summary Form and follow the provided format. Any deviation from the format will lead to disqualification.
    • A photo identity proof for each participant must be submitted.

Phase II: Final Presentation and Q&A:

  • Shortlisting: Shortlisted participants will deliver a 10-12 minute presentation, followed by a Q&A session.
  • Judging: Evaluation will be based on the judging criteria outlined in the problem statement.

Guidelines:

  • Executive Summary Form: All participants must fill the form provided and strictly follow the given format. Any failure to adhere will result in disqualification.
  • Original Work: Entries must be the original work of participants, with the team members being the primary owners of the venture. Plagiarism will lead to disqualification.
  • PDF Format: All documents should be converted to PDF format and submitted on the dashboard in one attempt.
  • Confidentiality: Entries will be treated confidentially.
  • Innovation: Entries should demonstrate innovative value, addressing a new need or providing an advancement over existing products/services/technologies.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open to students (undergraduate or postgraduate) and professionals worldwide.
  • Individual participation is allowed, though team participation is encouraged.
